Mother promises if son is spared she'll take instructions to be Catholic. Next a.m. patient was conscious - is here To-day still weak .... was enrolled frequently.

regions.full_page: E'd McNalley - 36 - of Garden City, Mich. - blood-tumor at birth has grown slowly but of late has caused trouble; was told if broken would cause death before he could get to hospital. Last Sunday morn- ing it broke - blood gushing forth; wife who is convert rushed to get cloth to stop it and at same time awoke the four children to pray for Papa. Bleeding was practically stopped when she got back to husband's side.
